description: Source code for the MergeRowsExec class in Apache Spark, implementing a logical plan node for performing merge operations with instructions for insert, update, delete, and copy, including metrics collection and row processing logic.

classes.name: MergeRowsExec
classes.description: A Spark logical plan node for executing merge operations with instructions for row-level modifications and metrics collection.

classes.name: MergeRowIterator
classes.description: Iterator that processes joined target and source rows to produce delete, update, insert, or copy actions based on instructions.

classes.name: InstructionExec
classes.description: Trait for instruction execution logic within merge process.

classes.name: KeepExec
classes.description: Instruction to keep (copy or update) a row.

classes.name: SplitExec
classes.description: Instruction to split a row into two different projections.

classes.name: CardinalityValidator
classes.description: Trait for validating row cardinality during merge.

classes.name: NoopCardinalityValidator
classes.description: No-operation validator that performs no checks.

classes.name: BitmapCardinalityValidator
classes.description: Validator that tracks row IDs using a Roaring bitmap to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: doExecute
methods.description: Executes the merge plan, returning an RDD of InternalRows after processing.

methods.name: createProjection
methods.description: Creates an UnsafeProjection from expressions and child output.

methods.name: createPredicate
methods.description: Generates a BasePredicate from an expression.

methods.name: planInstructions
methods.description: Converts instructions into executable instruction objects.

methods.name: applyInstructions
methods.description: Applies instructions to a row based on conditions.

methods.name: incrementCopyMetric
methods.description: Increments the counter for copied rows.

methods.name: incrementInsertMetric
methods.description: Increments the counter for inserted rows.

methods.name: incrementDeleteMetric
methods.description: Increments the counter for deleted rows, with source presence consideration.

methods.name: incrementUpdateMetric
methods.description: Increments the counter for updated rows, with source presence consideration.
